name: pump_stream_ingest
summary: Solana RPC live-logs ingest for pump.fun. Subscribes to a single program ID via `solana logs --url <RPC> <PROGRAM_ID>` (stdlib subprocess, zero pip deps), parses each transaction block into a canonical PumpEvent dataclass, and appends one JSON line per event to ~/.cc/pump_stream/<YYYY-MM-DD>.jsonl. The downstream feature extractor (agent B) consumes these jsonl files for opcode-router training data and live signal generation. v1 captures lightweight fields only (signature, slot, program, kind heuristic, raw_logs, status, err_code); amount/payer/mint/jito-tip are left as schema-stable zero defaults so the feature extractor can hydrate them on demand via getTransaction (solana_mcp.tx_status or a direct HTTP RPC call). Crystal-anchors only the session bookends — per-event crystallization would be too noisy for a busy pump.fun slot. Stdlib only: subprocess + json + pathlib + dataclasses.
engine_pattern: Drives `solana logs --url <RPC> --commitment confirmed <PROGRAM_ID>` as a long-lived Popen subprocess. Block-accumulator state machine reads stdout line-by-line: 'Transaction executed in slot N:' opens a block; 'Signature: <sig>' / 'Status: <s>' / 'Log Messages:' / indented 'Program …' lines populate it; the next slot-header (or stream end) flushes the prior block via _emit_event_from_block(). Each emitted block becomes one JSONL line. Friendly stderr warning when running against the public mainnet-beta RPC (rate-limited). Graceful no-op when the `solana` binary is absent — searches PUMP_SOLANA_BIN, then $PATH, then the Agave install at ~/.local/share/solana/install/active_release/bin/solana before bailing.

v1_limitation.what_is_captured: signature, slot, program ('pump.fun'|'pumpswap'|'unknown'), kind ('buy'|'sell'|'create_pool'|'remove_liquidity'|'unknown' — heuristic match against 'Program log: Instruction: <Kind>' lines), status ('ok'|'error_<code>'|'unknown'), err_code (e.g. '0x4' parsed from 'custom program error: 0x4'), raw_logs (capped at 128 lines per tx), wall-clock ts
v1_limitation.what_is_NOT_captured_v1: payer pubkey, mint address, sol_amount (lamports), token_amount, priority_fee_lamports, jito_tip_lamports — `solana logs` does NOT carry these in its text stream. Schema-stable zero defaults are emitted so the JSONL row count stays consistent.
v1_limitation.hydration_strategy: The feature extractor (agent B) reads each row and calls getTransaction via solana_mcp.tx_status (or a direct urllib.request POST to PUMP_RPC_HTTPS) to enrich payer/mint/amounts/fees. Hydration is lazy + opt-in so the ingest hot path stays cheap (one JSONL append per event, no HTTP fetch).
v1_limitation.why_not_websockets: `websockets` library is not installed; a stdlib raw-socket WebSocket client to logsSubscribe is possible but verbose (frame parsing, ping/pong, reconnect). v1 chose the `solana logs` subprocess as the transport for zero-dep simplicity. v2 can swap in a websockets-based or solana-py-based driver behind the same ingest_loop() API.

fields.ts: float — wall-clock epoch seconds at capture
fields.payer: str — wallet pubkey (v1: empty, hydrated by feature extractor)
fields.mint: str — token mint addr (v1: empty, hydrated)
fields.raw_logs: list[str] — log lines capped at 128 per tx

env_vars.PUMP_RPC_WSS: explicit WebSocket RPC override (Helius/Triton). solana CLI takes http(s); if a wss:// is passed it is auto-converted.
env_vars.PUMP_RPC_HTTPS: explicit HTTPS RPC override (used when PUMP_RPC_WSS unset)
env_vars.PUMP_SWAP_PROGRAM_ID: override for the PumpSwap AMM router program ID
env_vars.PUMP_SOLANA_BIN: absolute path to the `solana` binary (default search: $PATH then ~/.local/share/solana/install/active_release/bin/solana)

public_api: ingest_loop(duration_seconds=0, max_events=0, rpc_wss='', out_dir=None, program_id=PUMP_FUN_PROGRAM_ID) → int  // events_written
substrate: ~/.cc/pump_stream/*.jsonl (canonical capture store, one file per local date) + ~/.cc/inference_master_chain.jsonl (two session-bookend InferenceRecord rows per ingest_loop: scope='session_start' and scope='session_end', tier='pump_stream_session', model='solana_pump_stream')

inbound_callers: watchdog cron: keep one ingest_loop running per box
outbound_calls: subprocess: `solana logs --url <RPC> --commitment confirmed <PROGRAM_ID>` (long-lived Popen, stdout reader)
inference_logger.log (TWO calls per session: scope='session_start' / 'session_end', tier='pump_stream_session', model='solana_pump_stream')
routing_connections.substrate_reads: os.environ (PUMP_RPC_*, SOLANA_NETWORK, PUMP_SWAP_PROGRAM_ID, PUMP_SOLANA_BIN); no .env load — these are runtime knobs
routing_connections.substrate_writes: ~/.cc/pump_stream/<YYYY-MM-DD>.jsonl (one line per event); ~/.cc/inference_master_chain.jsonl (2 rows per session)

feature_extractor_handoff.downstream_consumer: agent B (next to be built) — reads ~/.cc/pump_stream/*.jsonl, hydrates payer/mint/amounts via getTransaction, emits feature vectors for the opcode-router training pipeline
feature_extractor_handoff.hydration_path: for each row → solana_mcp.tx_status(signature) OR direct POST to PUMP_RPC_HTTPS with getTransaction JSON-RPC body → enrich the row with parsed instruction args from the message's accountKeys + instructions list
feature_extractor_handoff.lazy_by_design: ingest stays cheap (one append per event); hydration runs on a slower cadence (batch by 100s or on demand) so feature extraction can prioritize hot mints

crystal_anchor_policy.per_event: NOT crystallized — too noisy for busy pump.fun slots. The JSONL itself is the per-event log of record.

guarantees: Stdlib only — no `websockets`, no `solana-py`, no `solders`, no `requests`. subprocess + json + pathlib + dataclasses + re only.
Append-only daily JSONL — one ~/.cc/pump_stream/<YYYY-MM-DD>.jsonl file per local date; rolling files capped naturally by the date change.
Schema-stable PumpEvent — all 14 fields always present even when not yet hydrated, so the JSONL never needs a migration when amounts are filled in later.
Graceful CLI failures — if `solana` binary is absent, ingest_loop() returns 0 with a friendly stderr ERROR (never raises into the caller).
Public-RPC rate-limit warning — when streaming via api.mainnet-beta.solana.com, a one-line WARN is emitted to stderr so production runs visibly know they should switch to Helius/Triton.
Bounded raw_logs — raw_logs is capped at 128 lines per tx so a pathological multi-CPI transaction can't blow up the JSONL row size.

Session crystal bookends — every ingest_loop() invocation emits two InferenceRecord rows (start + end) with the events_captured count + exit_reason so the chain has provable session boundaries without per-event noise.
Replay deterministic — replay_jsonl(path) yields PumpEvent rows in file order; tolerant of partial/malformed lines (skips them).
kinds_widening_note: studio/auth/keys.py KINDS is NOT widened for pump_stream. The RPC URLs are runtime knobs (no shared secret), read from os.environ. PUMP_SOLANA_BIN is a filesystem path, not a salted token. This stays consistent with the solana_mcp connector's same rationale.
usage_example:
from pump_stream_ingest import ingest_loop, replay_jsonl, PumpEvent
# short capture session — 60 seconds, max 500 events, public mainnet RPC (rate-limited warning to stderr)
n = ingest_loop(duration_seconds=60, max_events=500)
print(f'captured {n} events')
# replay yesterday's capture for analysis
from pathlib import Path; import time
p = Path.home()/'.cc/pump_stream'/f'{time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")}.jsonl'
for evt in replay_jsonl(p):
    if evt.kind == 'buy': print(evt.signature, evt.slot)
